content: The Munshaʾāt-i Yazdī preserves a business letter from Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī to Afżal al-Dīn Muḥammad Turka (Ibn Turka's nephew): Najīb al-Dīn Ḥabīb Allāh had left for Herat after a money dispute with his brother, and Sharaf al-Dīn intervened, lodging Ḥabīb Allāh at his own house and reallocating the money.
